criteria.silhouette_scale: Three connected angular yellow lobes with dark separating creases; compact mineral silhouette.
criteria.implementable_geometry: Transparent sprite using native generated-item extrusion; no complex mesh required.
criteria.mechanics_clearance: Static material item; no moving parts.
criteria.period_materials: Brimstone yellow and ochre mineral rather than shiny gold; plausible industrial raw ingredient.
criteria.family_consistency: Matches coarse clusters and upper-left light of approved cloth; uses fracture marks instead of fabric weave.
criteria.controls_readability: Native-size export keeps three faces and subordinate chips visible on light/dark backgrounds.
criteria.gameplay_scope: Existing sulfur item, no recipes or balance changes.
